says: In tsconfig.base.json, the comments on the Effect plugin's first two overrides still say they cover `next/` alone, but this PR extended both overrides to `kalfa/`.
proof: tsconfig.base.json:67 says '`next/` product code takes two more' and :71 says 'so they block in `next/` alone', while :73 and :96 now read "include": ["next/**/*.ts", "kalfa/**/*.ts", "next/**/*.tsx", "kalfa/**/*.tsx"]. The T910 test's doc comment at next/apps/fabrika/src/exam/effect-checks.test.ts:20 likewise still says 'what its override leaves out of `next/`'.
cost: A reader who trusts the comment thinks kalfa/ is outside these checks and may drop or move the kalfa globs without knowing they hold kalfa/ to next/'s standard (0556).
